documents.title: Board Meeting Intimation for Board Meeting Proposed To Be Held On 2Nd November, 2026 Pursuant To Regulation 29 Of The SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015 ('Listing Regulations'
Intimation Of Appointment Of Investor Relations (IR) And Public Relations (PR) Agency
Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018

analysis.summary: U. Y. Fincorp Limited reported strong financial performance for FY 2025-26, with revenue from operations reaching ₹16,164.13 Lakhs and profit before tax increasing to ₹6,664.38 Lakhs. The company expanded its lending portfolio to ₹35,652.97 Lakhs as of March 31, 2026, and diversified its offerings by introducing equipment financing under the 'GrowU.money' brand and small-ticket loans through a partnership with Fintech Cloud Private Limited under the 'Fundobaba' brand. Management remains optimistic about long-term economic prospects while maintaining a disciplined focus on asset quality, risk management, and regulatory compliance.

guidance.claim: Management stated that the demand for credit is projected to grow by 13.5-14.0 percent.
guidance.quote: As the country progresses, demand for credit is likely to remain strong, especially among Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSMEs) and retail, and is projected to grow by 13.5-14.0 per cent.

demand_outlook.claim: Management states that India's real GDP grew by 7.7% in FY 2025-26 according to provisional estimates released by the National Statistical Office.
demand_outlook.quote: According to the Provisional Estimates released by the National Statistical Office, India's real GDP grew by 7.7% in FY 2025-26, compared with 7.1% in FY 2024-25.

demand_outlook.claim: Management notes that increasing formalisation, financial inclusion, digitalisation, and growing demand for organised credit have created significant opportunities for NBFCs.
demand_outlook.quote: Increasing formalisation of the economy, financial inclusion, digitalisation and growing demand for organised credit have created significant opportunities for NBFCs.

demand_outlook.claim: Management notes that the NBFC industry continues to face challenges relating to asset quality, competition, funding conditions, interest-rate movements, and an evolving regulatory environment.
demand_outlook.quote: At the same time, the industry continues to face challenges relating to asset quality, competition, funding conditions, interest-rate movements and an evolving regulatory environment.

demand_outlook.claim: Management states that India's continued economic development, business formalisation, increasing organised credit penetration, and MSME growth provide a favourable long-term opportunity.
demand_outlook.quote: India's continued economic development, formalisation of businesses, increasing penetration of organised credit and growth of MSMEs provide a favourable long-term opportunity for our business.

demand_outlook.claim: Management remains optimistic about the long-term prospects of the Indian economy and the NBFC sector.
demand_outlook.quote: Looking ahead, we remain optimistic about the long-term prospects of the Indian economy and the NBFC sector.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that global GDP growth is expected to remain low at 3% for 2024.
demand_outlook.quote: Global GDP growth is expected to remain low at 3% for 2024.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that inflation has softened and is expected to continue to moderate.
demand_outlook.quote: Encouragingly, inflation has softened over the highs of the previous year and is expected to continue to moderate.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that demand for credit is likely to remain strong, especially among MSMEs and retail.
demand_outlook.quote: As the country progresses, demand for credit is likely to remain strong, especially among Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSMEs) and retail, and is projected to grow by 13.5-14.0 per cent.

capex_expansion.claim: The company entered into a contractual joint venture agreement with Fintech Cloud Private Limited on April 9, 2025, for small-ticket personal and business loans under the brand 'FUNDOBABA'.
capex_expansion.quote: During the period under review, the Board of Directors of the Company at their meeting held on 9th April, 2025, inter alia considered and approved the contractual joint venture agreement dated 9th April, 2025 entered into by the Company with Fintech Cloud Private Limited (FCPL) for expansion of its business into the field on small ticket size Personal and Business Loan under its new brand name “FUNDOBABA”.

capex_expansion.claim: The company approved the opening of a new branch office at Lucknow for business expansion under the brand name GrowU.Money.
capex_expansion.quote: During the year under review, the Board of Directors at its meeting held on 3rd May, 2024 inter alia considered and approved the proposal of opening of the Company’s new branch office at Lucknow for the purpose of expansion of its business operation in the area of Lucknow under the brand name “GrowU.Money”.

capex_expansion.claim: The Board approved a contractual joint venture agreement with Fintech Cloud Private Limited to expand business into small-ticket size personal and business loans under the brand name FUNDOBABA.
capex_expansion.quote: The Board of Directors of the Company at their meeting held on 9th April, 2025, inter alia considered and approved the contractual joint venture agreement dated 9th April, 2025 entered into by the Company with Fintech Cloud Private Limited (FCPL) for expansion of its business into the field on small ticket size Personal and Business Loan under its new brand name “FUNDOBABA”.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is expanding further into central and eastern Uttar Pradesh covering multiple specific regions.
capex_expansion.quote: After GrowU has received positive response in the areas of and Kanpur and Lucknow, it is now inter alia expanding further into central and eastern Uttar Pradesh covering Prayagraj, Varanasi, Sonbhadra, Ayodhya, Deoria and Gorakhpur regions.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is expanding its business operations into newer loan segments under the brand name 'GrowU. Money' into central and eastern Uttar Pradesh.
capex_expansion.quote: Expansion of business operations into newer loan segments under the New Brand name “GrowU. Money” has received positive response under its pilot project in the areas of lucknow and Kanpur, it is now inter alia expanding further into central and eastern Uttar Pradesh covering Prayagraj, Varanasi, Sonbhadra, Ayodhya, Deoria and Gorakhpur regions.

capex_expansion.claim: The company digitalized the onboarding and disbursement process for small ticket-sized loans.
capex_expansion.quote: The Company has also digitalized the onboarding disbusrement process of small ticket sized Loan with the monthly run rate of approx Rs. 100 Lakhs with an interest rate ranging between 24-33% p.a.

margins_costs.claim: Management reported a revenue from operations of Rs. 12,185.29 lakhs for FY2023-24 compared to Rs. 5,557.17 lakhs in the previous year.
margins_costs.quote: re-assured stability and soundness in terms of overall business performance by achieving revenue from operations of `12,185.29 Lakhs as against ` 5,557.17 Lakhs in the previous year and recorded profit before tax of ` 8,437.63 Lakhs as against ` 1,110.86 lakhs in the financial year 2022-23.

orders_capacity.claim: The company's lending portfolio expanded to ₹35,652.97 Lakhs as at March 31, 2026.
orders_capacity.quote: Our lending portfolio also expanded meaningfully during the year, reaching ₹35,652.97 Lakhs as at March 31, 2026, compared with ₹27,457.34 Lakhs as at March 31, 2025.

orders_capacity.claim: The company has disbursed loans to more than 18,000 customers across India.
orders_capacity.quote: The Company has disbursed loans to more than 18,000 customers across India.

orders_capacity.claim: The company disbursed loans to more than 3,800 customers across customer locations in Uttar Pradesh through its branch and business correspondent network.
orders_capacity.quote: The Company had disbursed loan to more than 3,800 customers, across more than 2 Customer Locations in Uttar Pradesh, through its network of 2 branches, & 6 Business Correspondents.

orders_capacity.claim: Management reported building a loan portfolio exceeding 14 crore INR while keeping the NPA rate below 2 percent.
orders_capacity.quote: In just one year, Company has built a loan portfolio exceeding 14 crore INR keeping the NPA rate below 2 percent.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board of Directors did not recommend any dividend for the financial year ended March 31, 2025.
capital_allocation.quote: The Directors of your Company do not recommend any dividend for the financial year ended 31st March, 2025 in order to plough back the resources for future growth.

capital_allocation.claim: The Directors did not recommend any dividend for FY2023-24 to plough back resources for future growth.
capital_allocation.quote: The Directors of your Company do not recommend any dividend for the financial year ended 31st March, 2024 in order to plough back the resources for future growth.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management observed that the year under review was characterised by geopolitical tensions, changing trade policies, commodity price volatility, elevated global debt, and uncertainty in international financial markets.
risks_headwinds.quote: The year under review was characterised by a rapidly evolving global economic environment. Geopolitical tensions, changing trade policies, commodity price volatility, elevated global debt and uncertainty in international financial markets continued to influence economic activity across regions.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management cited multiple global uncertainty factors including ongoing geopolitical conflicts, widespread elevation of debt, extreme weather conditions, and elections.
risks_headwinds.quote: Multiple factors like the on-going geopolitical conflicts, wide-spread elevation of debt, extreme weather conditions and elections in many parts of the world continue to contribute to the uncertainty of the Global Economic Outlook.

management_commitments.claim: The company intends to build upon existing strengths by expanding operations in existing markets, selectively entering newer geographies, and exploring organic and inorganic opportunities.
management_commitments.quote: We intend to build upon our existing strengths by expanding our operations in existing markets, selectively entering newer geographies and exploring organic as well as inorganic opportunities, while remaining within our risk appetite.

management_commitments.claim: The company aims to expand operations in existing areas and newer geographies through organic and inorganic opportunities.
management_commitments.quote: The Company aims to create value for its customers, employees, and shareholders, by expanding operations in existing areas, expanding to newer geographies through organic, as well as inorganic opportunities and exploring new ways in its journey to the ‘next’.

management_commitments.claim: The company intends to continue its efforts of mainstreaming financial inclusion and providing affordable credit.
management_commitments.quote: The Company intends to continue its efforts of mainstreaming financial inclusion and providing affordable credit to customers in the lower half of the socio-economic pyramid.

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to enter new geographical markets and diversify service offerings to open up new revenue streams.
management_commitments.quote: Expansion into New Markets: Plans to enter new geographical markets and diversify service offerings are likely to open up new revenue streams.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
